title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #5

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How many verses does Surah An-Naas have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 7

2. What is a chapter of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. An ayah
   B. A rak'ah
   C. A surah
   D. A sujud

3. Which surah has only three verses? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Kafirun
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Masad

4. Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Because they trusted him
   B. Because he lived in the mountain
   C. Because he was afraid
   D. Because he was the richest

5. Which job did the young Muhammad (S.A.W.) do? (1 mark)
   A. Blacksmith only
   B. Judge
   C. Soldier
   D. Shepherd and later trader

6. The Kiswahili word for the tooth-cleaning stick or brush is (1 mark)
   A. Mswaki
   B. Kofia
   C. Kanzu
   D. Mkeka

7. What does "Ar-Rahim" mean? (1 mark)
   A. The Source of Peace
   B. The All-Hearing
   C. The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   D. The Owner of the Day

8. Neema tells the truth instead of lying at school. Which angels' duty helped her remember? (1 mark)
   A. Raqib and Atid
   B. Mikail
   C. Israfil
   D. Jibril

9. Which surah verse says angels do not disobey Allah's command? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:2
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 66:6
   D. Qur'an 112:1

10. How many types of najasaat are taught in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Seven
   B. Three
   C. Five
   D. Two

11. What is mud on your clothes? (1 mark)
   A. A medium najasa
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A light najasa
   D. Normal dirt, not a najasa

12. Kamal made wudhu at 6 a.m. and only ate lunch. Is wudhu still valid? (1 mark)
   A. Only if he sleeps
   B. No
   C. Only if he rinses
   D. Yes

13. What is a nullifier of wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Something that breaks wudhu
   B. A step of wudhu
   C. A drink
   D. A prayer

14. What do we recite after wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. Nothing
   C. Surah Al-Masad
   D. The testimony of faith

15. What must a girl cover during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Only the arms
   B. Nothing
   C. Only the head
   D. The whole body except face and hands

16. What do we say in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   C. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   D. Bismillah

17. What is ruku? (1 mark)
   A. Prostrating
   B. Sitting
   C. Bowing
   D. Standing

18. What do we say when sitting between the two sujud? (1 mark)
   A. La ilaha
   B. Amin
   C. Bismillah
   D. Rabbighfir li

19. Which is a pillar and not a condition? (1 mark)
   A. Time of prayer
   B. Wudhu
   C. Facing the Qibla
   D. Ruku

20. Why should we not pollute rivers? (1 mark)
   A. Fish and other creatures live there
   B. Only people use rivers
   C. Fish do not matter
   D. Rivers are ugly

21. In the Prophet's story, a woman was punished because she (1 mark)
   A. Gave a cat milk
   B. Adopted a cat
   C. Fed a cat
   D. Starved a cat she had tied up

22. Which is a dressing trend to avoid? (1 mark)
   A. Neat trousers
   B. Simple kanzu
   C. Clothes worn to show off
   D. Clean uniform

23. Which of these is broadcast media? (1 mark)
   A. Poster
   B. Book
   C. Radio
   D. Magazine

24. What should come before screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Prayer, homework and helping at home
   B. Games
   C. Nothing
   D. Videos

25. Which is a negative use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Calling grandmother
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Listening to Qur'an
   D. Studying

26. What is sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. A loan
   B. Charity given to please Allah
   C. A tax
   D. A game

27. Which group deserves help? (1 mark)
   A. A healthy person who refuses to work
   B. A person who wants an easy life
   C. A person who wants toys
   D. A person who lost his farm in a flood

28. What does the dua for leaving the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. Allah is the Greatest
   B. In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   C. In the name of Allah we enter
   D. Glory to my Lord

29. Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 40:60
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:1

30. How should parents correct children? (1 mark)
   A. With wisdom and gentleness
   B. By ignoring
   C. With cruelty
   D. By insults

31. Who is a shepherd responsible for his flock according to the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Only traders
   B. Only kings
   C. Only teachers
   D. Every person responsible for those in his care

32. Which is a good way to say sorry to a parent? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Say sorry politely and try to improve
   C. Refuse
   D. Blame

33. When should we not obey parents? (1 mark)
   A. When they call us
   B. When they ask for water
   C. When they command something Allah forbids
   D. When they ask us to study

34. Who is a "shangazi"? (1 mark)
   A. Mother's brother
   B. Father's sister
   C. Cousin
   D. Grandfather

35. What did Khadija do when the Prophet returned frightened? (1 mark)
   A. Left
   B. Blamed him
   C. Ignored him
   D. Comforted and covered him

36. Who was the Prophet's close friend who believed at once? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Waraqa
   C. Abu Jahl
   D. Abu Lahab

37. Whose bed did Ali sleep in on the night of the Prophet's migration? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal's
   B. The Prophet's
   C. Abu Bakr's
   D. Khadija's

38. Apart from Ibrahim, whose children were all the Prophet's children? (1 mark)
   A. Aisha's
   B. Safiyya's
   C. Khadija's
   D. Hafsa's

39. What is perseverance? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping on with determination
   B. Giving up
   C. Laziness
   D. Anger

40. Why did the Prophet go to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. To relax
   B. To trade
   C. To hide
   D. To invite people to Islam

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

42. How can planting a tree be an act of worship? (2 marks)

43. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

44. State three things that do not nullify wudhu. (3 marks)

45. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

46. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

47. Explain what integrity means when using a phone. (3 marks)

48. Explain how not brushing teeth can harm them. (4 marks)

49. Explain why Muslims do not worship angels. (3 marks)

50. Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision. (3 marks)

51. Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an. (3 marks)

52. Name the three types of najasaat. (3 marks)

53. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

54. Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals". (3 marks)

55. In a group role-play, a child finds Ksh 50 in the school field. Explain what a person of the Prophet's character would do and why. (5 marks)

56. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)

57. Give three positive uses of media. (3 marks)

58. Explain the lesson from the story of the man who gave a dog water. (3 marks)

59. State three groups of people who deserve help. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 6
   An-Naas has six verses.

2. C — A surah
   A surah is a chapter made of ayat.

3. A — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

4. A — Because they trusted him
   He was called Al-Amin.

5. D — Shepherd and later trader
   He herded sheep and later traded honestly.

6. A — Mswaki
   Mswaki means toothbrush or chewing stick.

7. C — The Most Merciful, with special mercy to believers
   Ar-Rahim is Allah's special mercy.

8. A — Raqib and Atid
   They record what we say.

9. C — Qur'an 66:6
   Surah At-Tahrim 66:6 states this.

10. B — Three
   Light, medium and heavy.

11. D — Normal dirt, not a najasa
   Mud is not najasa though we clean for neatness.

12. D — Yes
   Eating does not break wudhu.

13. A — Something that breaks wudhu
   It cancels the state of wudhu.

14. D — The testimony of faith
   Ash-hadu an la ilaha illallah...

15. D — The whole body except face and hands
   This is the minimum for girls.

16. B — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

17. C — Bowing
   Ruku is bowing.

18. D — Rabbighfir li
   My Lord, forgive me.

19. D — Ruku
   Ruku is inside the prayer.

20. A — Fish and other creatures live there
   Pollution harms creatures.

21. D — Starved a cat she had tied up
   She did not feed it or let it find food.

22. C — Clothes worn to show off
   Showing off is disliked.

23. C — Radio
   Radio and television broadcast.

24. A — Prayer, homework and helping at home
   Priorities first.

25. B — Spreading rumours
   Rumours can hurt.

26. B — Charity given to please Allah
   Sadaqah is voluntary charity.

27. D — A person who lost his farm in a flood
   Disaster victims deserve help.

28. B — In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   That is the meaning.

29. A — Qur'an 40:60
   Surah Ghafir 40:60.

30. A — With wisdom and gentleness
   Islam forbids cruelty.

31. D — Every person responsible for those in his care
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

32. B — Say sorry politely and try to improve
   Apologise.

33. C — When they command something Allah forbids
   Obedience is in what is good.

34. B — Father's sister
   Shangazi is father's sister.

35. D — Comforted and covered him
   She reassured him.

36. A — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq.

37. B — The Prophet's
   He did so to protect the Prophet.

38. C — Khadija's
   All his children except Ibrahim were from Khadija.

39. A — Keeping on with determination
   The Prophet continued to invite.

40. D — To invite people to Islam
   He wanted support.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eating, drinking, talking, laughing quietly, sweating.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Food and sugar stay on the teeth, germs turn them into acid, and acid makes cavities which cause toothache and bad breath.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the four steps or harms.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Angels are servants of Allah created to obey Him. Worship belongs to Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for servants of Allah, 1 mark for obey, 1 mark for worship only to Allah.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mukhaffafah (light), mutawassitah (medium) and mughalladha (heavy).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

55. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hand it to the teacher so the owner can be found. Honesty and trustworthiness. It is not ours, and Allah sees everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for honesty, 1 mark for trust, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for a clear explanation.

56. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: A small act of kindness can earn Allah's forgiveness and reward, and there is reward in serving every living creature.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for forgiveness, 1 mark for all creatures.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: People in debt, people who lost property through disaster, and the destitute.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
